title: Punctuation
content:
Definition

English: Punctuation refers to the use of symbols in writing to separate sentences, clauses, or words, making the meaning clear and the text easier to read.
Hindi: Viram chihn likhit bhasha mein chihnon ka prayog hai jo vakyas, upvakyas, ya shabdon ko alag karte hain, arth ko spasht aur pathan ko saral banate hain.

It organizes and structures written language.
Yeh likhit bhasha ko vyavasthit aur sanrachit karta hai.

Example: Let's eat, Grandma! (With comma) vs. Let's eat Grandma! (Without comma).
Hindi: Chalo, Dadi, khana khaate hain! (Alpa viram ke saath) vs. Chalo Dadi khana khaate hain! (Bina alpa viram).

title: Full Stop (Period)
content:
Definition

English: A full stop (.) marks the end of a declarative sentence or an abbreviation.
Hindi: Poorna viram (.) ek vivaranatmak vakya ya sankshiptakshar ke ant ko darshata hai.

Use

Used to indicate a complete thought or end of a statement.
Poorn vichar ya kathan ke ant ke liye.

Example: She is reading a book.
Hindi: Woh ek kitaab padh rahi hai.

title: Comma
content:
Definition

English: A comma (,) separates elements in a list, clauses, or phrases to improve clarity.
Hindi: Alpa viram (,) soochi, up Florida, or phrases ke beech alag karta hai aur spashtata badhata hai.

Use

Used in lists, to separate clauses, or to mark non-essential information.
Soochi mein, upvakyas ke beech, ya gair-zaruri jankari ke liye.

Example: I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
Hindi: Maine seb, santre, aur kele kharide.

title: Question Mark
content:
Definition

English: A question mark (?) indicates the end of an interrogative sentence.
Hindi: Prashna chihn (?) prashnavachak vakya ke ant ko darshata hai.

Use

Used to show a question is being asked.
Prashn poochhe jane ko dikhane ke liye.

Example: Where are you going?
Hindi: Tum kahan ja rahe ho?

title: Exclamation Mark
content:
Definition

English: An exclamation mark (!) indicates excitement, surprise, or emphasis in an exclamatory sentence.
Hindi: Vismay soochak chihn (!) vismayadibodhak vakya mein uttejana, ashcharya, ya zor dikhata hai.

Use

Used to express strong emotion or emphasis.
Teez bhavna ya zor dikhane ke liye.

Example: What a beautiful sunset!
Hindi: Kya sundar suryast hai!

title: Semicolon
content:
Definition

English: A semicolon (;) separates two independent clauses that are closely related or balances items in a complex list.
Hindi: Upviram (;) do swatantra upvakyas ko alag karta hai jo ek doosre se sambandhit hote hain ya jटil soochi mein santulan banata hai.

Use

Used to connect related ideas or clarify complex lists.
Sambandhit vicharon ko jodne ya jटil soochiyon ko spasht karne ke liye.

Example: She loves reading; he prefers movies.
Hindi: Use padhna pasand hai; woh filmein pasand karta hai.

title: Colon
content:
Definition

English: A colon (:) introduces a list, explanation, or elaboration.
Hindi: Visham chihn (:) ek soochi, vyakhya, ya vistaran ka parichay deta hai.

Use

Used to introduce or emphasize what follows.
Agla vivaran prastut ya uspar zor dene ke liye.

Example: I need three things: a pen, a notebook, and coffee.
Hindi: Mujhe teen cheezein chahiye: ek pen, ek notebook, aur coffee.

title: Apostrophe
content:
Definition

English: An apostrophe (') shows possession or forms contractions.
Hindi: Apasvar chihn (') swaamitva dikhata hai ya sankochan banata hai.

Use

Used to indicate ownership or combine words (e.g., don't, can't).
Swaamitva ya shabd jodne ke liye (jaise, nahi, nahi kar sakta).

Example: This is John's book. I can't come.
Hindi: Yeh John ki kitaab hai. Main nahi aa sakta.

title: Quotation Marks
content:
Definition

English: Quotation marks ('') or ("") enclose direct speech, quotes, or specific words/phrases.
Hindi: Udharan chihn ('') ya ("") sidhe vachan, uddharan, ya vishesh shabd/vakyansh ko gherte hain.

Use

Used to indicate direct speech or highlight specific terms.
Sidhe vachan ya vishesh shabdon ko ujaagar karne ke liye.

Example: She said, "I love reading."
Hindi: Usne kaha, "Mujhe padhna pasand hai."

title: Parentheses
content:
Definition

English: Parentheses (()) enclose additional or explanatory information.
Hindi: Kramik chihn (()) atirikt ya vyakhyatmak jankari ko gherte hain.

Use

Used to add extra details without disrupting the main sentence.
Mukhya vakya mein badhal daale bina atirikt jankari jodne ke liye.

Example: He arrived late (as usual).
Hindi: Woh der se pahuncha (hamesha ki tarah).

title: Hyphen and Dash
content:
Definition

English: A hyphen (-) joins compound words or separates syllables. A dash (– or —) separates phrases or indicates a pause.
Hindi: Yojak chihn (-) samyukt shabd jodta hai ya akshar alag karta hai. Dash (– ya —) vakyansh alag karta hai ya viram dikhata hai.

Use

Hyphen for word formation; dash for separation or emphasis.
Yojak chihn shabd nirmaan ke liye; dash alag karne ya zor dene ke liye.

Example: A well-known author – she wrote many books – visited us.
Hindi: Ek prasiddh lekhika – usne kai kitaabein likhi – humse mili.
